modal.selectionDesc: These notes will be published or updated on Leaflet: {{list}}.

account.identifierDesc: Your handle (alice.bsky.social), your DID or your email.
account.passwordDesc: Create one in Bluesky → Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords.
account.pdsDesc: Leave empty to find it from your handle. Required for an email login on a PDS other than Bluesky.
account.testDesc: Log in and load your publications.

publication.defaultDesc: Where new notes are published. Override per note with the "leaflet_publication" property.
publication.refreshDesc: Reload the publications of your account.

frontmatter.title: Title property
frontmatter.titleDesc: Falls back to the first heading, then to the file name.
frontmatter.coverDesc: Vault path, wikilink or URL of the cover image.
frontmatter.slugDesc: Record key used in the URL on first publish.
frontmatter.writeDesc: Store the record URI and URL in the note after publishing. Required to update a post.
frontmatter.publishDesc: Set it to true to mark a note for publishing, false to block it.
frontmatter.requireFlagDesc: Refuse to publish a note unless its publish property is true.

content.slugAsKeyDesc: Build the post URL from the slug or file name instead of a random identifier.
content.firstHeadingDesc: Remove a leading H1 from the body and use it as the title.
content.wikilinksDesc: How links to other notes are converted.
content.wikilinksPublished: Link to the published note when available
content.linkCardsDesc: Turn a link alone on its line into a card, Bluesky post or YouTube embed.
content.remoteImagesDesc: Download images from URLs and upload them to your PDS.
content.codeThemeDesc: Syntax highlighting theme used by Leaflet.
content.maxWidthDesc: Larger images are resized. Images are compressed under 1 MB.
content.dataviewDesc: Replace the queries with their result. When disabled, queries are removed. Requires the Dataview plugin.
content.calloutsQuote: Quote with emoji and colored title

after.heading: When publishing
after.confirmDesc: Show the notes before publishing a folder, a selection or all marked notes.

pages.accountDesc: Bluesky handle, app password and PDS.
pages.publicationDesc: Where notes are published and the default post preferences.
pages.contentDesc: How Obsidian Markdown becomes a Leaflet post.
pages.propertiesDesc: Note properties read and written by the plugin.

network.proxy: Cannot reach {{host}} through the proxy ({{code}}). Check the proxy or VPN settings of your system, or try another network.
network.offline: No internet connection ({{code}}). Check your network and try again.
network.dns: {{host}} cannot be found ({{code}}). Check the handle and the PDS URL, or your DNS settings.
network.certificate: The secure connection to {{host}} failed ({{code}}). A proxy, antivirus or wrong system date can cause this.
network.connection: The connection to {{host}} failed ({{code}}). The server may be down, or a firewall blocks it. Try again later.
network.blocked: The request to {{host}} was blocked ({{code}}), probably by a firewall or a filtering extension.

http.unavailable: {{host}} is not answering right now (HTTP {{status}}). The server may be down, or a proxy on your network blocks the connection. Try again later.
http.rateLimited: Too many requests to {{host}} (HTTP {{status}}). Wait a few minutes and try again.
http.denied: {{host}} refused the request (HTTP {{status}}). A proxy or firewall on your network may block it.
http.notPds: {{host}} does not look like an AT Protocol server (HTTP {{status}}). Check the PDS URL in the settings, or leave it empty.
http.unexpected: Unexpected answer from {{host}} (HTTP {{status}}). Check the PDS URL in the settings, or leave it empty.
